surface_roughness_nm: 0.5-0.6 nm for Hf3N4, 0.8 nm at 200 °C and 0.5 nm at 175 °C for Zr3N4
evidence: The films were characterized by Rutherford backscattering spectrometry and ellipsometry. These films were amorphous as deposited, as shown by X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy. The surface roughness of the deposited layer for Hf3N4 was minimal [root-mean-square (rms) roughness) 0.5-0.6 nm]. The nitride films have very smooth surfaces. TEM and XRD revealed that the films as deposited were amorphous.
